items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Maybe sometime in between I would do something with somebody else, with Babs Gonzales or somebody

ctx.x: Were you doing tours, while you were with Norman Granz – no, not Norman Granz.

Yeah. We were traveling all over the country, a lot of different places. There was some time off. Maybe sometime in between I would do something with somebody else, with Babs Gonzales or somebody – something uptown.
Can we backtrack and go back to your first recording session?
